name: Excellent Strike
description: Adds one die to a single attack per mote spent, to a maximum of double the character's Dexterity + Melee dice pool.

name: Hungry Tiger Technique
description: The attack's extra successes are counted as automatic damage successes; the Essence must be spent before the attack roll.

name: Fire and Stones Strike
description: Adds an extra die of damage for each mote of Essence spent, up to the character's Strength; a botched damage roll may break ordinary weapons.

name: One Weapon, Two Blows
description: Lets the character attack twice in one turn; the two attacks are rolled separately.

name: Peony Blossom Attack
description: Buys multiple additional attacks in a turn (2 motes per extra attack, up to the character's Essence), each at the full dice pool.

name: Iron Whirlwind Attack
description: A flurry of strikes and thrusts, splitting the Melee dice pool among as many attacks as the character's Dexterity.

name: Retrieve the Fallen Weapon
description: Calls a dropped or thrown weapon back into the character's hand.

name: Call the Blade
description: Summons a visible weapon across a distance into the character's hand.

name: Summoning the Loyal Steel
description: Summons or banishes a single attuned weapon to or from Elsewhere.

name: Glorious Solar Saber
description: Forms a blade of pure Essence in hand, dealing base lethal damage equal to the character's Strength, lasting a scene.

name: Iron Raptor Technique
description: Hurls a melee weapon as a ranged attack out to (Dexterity x5) yards, after which it returns to hand.

name: Sandstorm-Wind Attack
description: Charges the weapon with Essence to strike a distant target, dealing lethal damage.

name: Edge of Morning Sunlight
description: Invests the weapon with Essence to deal aggravated damage against creatures of darkness and the undead.

name: Corona of Radiance
description: Wreathes the weapon in burning Essence for a scene, dealing aggravated damage to the undead and creatures of darkness.

name: Blazing Solar Bolt
description: Channels Solar Essence into a leaping bolt that strikes a distant target for the weapon's damage, aggravated to creatures of Malfeas and the Underworld.

name: Golden Essence Block
description: Adds parry dice against an attack the character is aware of, one die per 2 motes spent.

name: Dipping Swallow Defense
description: Parries an attack the character is aware of, even one normally too fast to block.

name: Bulwark Stance
description: Until the next action, the character may parry any attack she is aware of with no dice penalty for multiple defenses.

name: Heavenly Guardian Defense
description: Perfectly blocks a single attack the character is aware of, even normally unblockable ones.

name: Fivefold Bulwark Stance
description: For a scene, perfectly blocks attacks the character is aware of, even normally unblockable ones.

name: Solar Counterattack
description: An immediate counterattack at full Dexterity + Melee against anyone making a hand-to-hand attack; not an action and repeatable as motes allow.

name: Ready in Eight Directions Stance
description: Until the next action, responds to all incoming hand-to-hand attacks with an immediate full counterattack.
